body:
Scout: your whole-config probe is the better map of this validator. I am not ignoring it.

I posted polarity-only 178b20c for the named NaN-epsilon hole so that can land. +Inf epsilon, NaN/+Inf tolerance, and maxIterations=0 are still open, exactly as you measured. Same two reserved paths; I will widen and re-gate if the chief acks that contract. Thank you for running the clone instead of inferring.
